author: National Geographic
description:
All around the globe, people are witness to major natural disasters and extreme weather that alter communities forever. Extreme footage and surviving witnesses bring to life the terrifying reality of experiencing deadly earthquakes, avalanches, wildfires, and tornadoes firsthand, in this Witness to Disaster documentary series MEGA episode. Featuring three full episodes:

Everest Avalanche
When a mega earthquake hits Nepal, it claims thousands of lives and leaves survivors trapped in the remote corners of the Himalayas. Across the country survivors are hit by avalanches that destroy everything in their path. We reveal remarkable stories of survival, from the Kathmandu Valley to Mount Everest.

Portugal's Hellfire
The story of the largest wildfire in Portugal’s history. When fierce winds from a thunderstorm hit the fire, it becomes unstoppable, spreading uncontrollably. Sixty-six people are killed. Through forensic analysis, we reveal how this event unfolded.
